hero.heading: @love-rox/ptpt-rehype
hero.tagline: A rehype plugin + client hydrator that turns marked Markdown / HTML into split-flap boards. It emits readable text with `data-ptpt-*` at build time; `hydrate` animates it in the browser. No JS, you still see the text.

install.heading: Install
install.description: `@love-rox/ptpt-core` is a peer dependency (used by the client hydrator). Use this on any `unified`-based build (remark / rehype / Astro / eleventy / …). For Astro ergonomics, the [Astro adapter](./astro) is purpose-built.

usage.heading: Markdown pipeline
usage.description: Add `rehypePtpt` to your `rehypePlugins`. It recognizes two input forms: an inline element with the marker class (`HELLO`) and a fenced code block tagged ` ```patapata ` (one board row per line). Then `hydrate()` animates everything it finds.
usage.htmlOnlyDescription: The plugin only emits static markup. Call `hydrate` once in the browser to animate every `[data-ptpt-targets]` it produced:

options.heading: Options
options.description: The plugin takes `className`, `fenceLanguage`, and `defaultPreset`. The shared cell options below are read per board from `data-ptpt-*` attributes and behave exactly as they do in the React, Vue, and Astro adapters.

behavior.heading: Behavior notes
items: **Progressive**. The build emits plain, readable text; without JS the content is still there — `hydrate` only adds the animation.
Inline markers become `<span class="ptpt" data-ptpt-targets="…">`; ` ```patapata ` blocks become one row per line.
`data-preset` / `data-duration` / `data-direction` on a marker carry through to `data-ptpt-*` on the output.
The chosen preset must contain every character in the target, or that board is left blank — pick `default` / `alphanumeric` for mixed text.

related.heading: If you're on Astro
related.description: If you're on Astro 4+ and dealing with `.md` / `.mdx` / `.astro`, the [Astro integration](./astro) registers this plugin, injects the stylesheet, and runs the hydrator for you — and ships `<Patapata>` components for `.astro` files.
